entry.title: ACID Cold Infusion Tea — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Ginger ale, iced tea, citrus drink (projected)
Occasion: Pre-cut aromatic session, afternoon smoke, warm-weather smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Black tea, peach, cream, fresh pine, herbs and light citrus give Cold Infusion Tea a bright aromatic profile that is very different from the darker coffee-and-cocoa infused cigars in the catalogue. The Connecticut Shade wrapper keeps the tobacco soft and creamy while the infusion adds floral, botanical and lightly sweet notes. Expect a smooth, fragrant smoke with tea and peach through the middle and a clean herbal-pine finish rather than heavy earth or pepper.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigar Hut currently lists the single at A$51 and offers it for purchase.
practicalLines: Pre-cut before lighting into two ~3⅜″ × 44 sessions
